entities.summary: Andreas Zack Shipanga was a Namibian politician known for the "Shipanga Affair", a movement within SWAPO that sought to elect a new leadership and whose followers were in response detained without trial. Imprisoned for two years following this fall-out, Shipanga was arrested and held in detention in Zambia then Tanzania until 1978.
